attractions.name_base: Dongjiaominxiang Embassy Quarter (东交民巷使馆建筑群)
attractions.name_local: 北京东交民巷使馆建筑群
attractions.location_local: 北京市东城区东交民巷（崇文门地铁站A1口附近）
attractions.notes_base: Beijing's longest hutong, uniquely lined with European-style legation buildings from the early 20th century. Perfect light morning walk on arrival day — free, unhurried, no tickets. Key spots: Saint Michael's Catholic Church (哥特式圣弥厄尔大教堂), China Court Museum (中国法院博物馆), Belgian Embassy ruins (比利时使馆旧址). Connects naturally via West Xinglongstreet (西兴隆街) to Qianmen area. Verified via RedNote (879 likes, spring citywalk route). Allow 1.5-2 hours.
attractions.notes_local: 北京最长的胡同，沿途林立20世纪初欧式使馆建筑。抵京第一天理想的轻松晨间漫步，免费无需门票。推荐打卡：圣弥厄尔大教堂、中国法院博物馆、比利时使馆旧址、台基厂大街。经西兴隆街可自然延伸至大栅栏前门区域。小红书已验证（879赞，春季citywalk路线）。建议游览1.5-2小时。

attractions.location_local: 北京市东城区前门大街
attractions.notes_base: Iconic pedestrian shopping street dating back 600 years. Walk through after dinner at Siji Minfu on the way to Yangmeizhu Xiejie. Free to walk.
attractions.notes_local: 历史悠久的步行商业街，有600年历史。四季民福晚餐后步行穿往前门大街前往杨梅竹斜街。

attractions.location_local: 北京市西城区杨梅竹斜街
attractions.notes_base: XHS top-rated hutong (7316 likes). Artsy independent shops, warm evening streetlamps, perfect Golden Week crowd avoidance. Adjacent to Dashilar.
attractions.notes_local: 小红书最受欢迎胡同（7316赞），独立艺术店铺，温暖街灯，黄金周完美避crowd，毗邻大栅栏。

attractions.location_local: 北京市怀柔区慕田峪
attractions.notes_base: Best Great Wall section for foreign visitors. Less crowded than Badaling, better scenery, with cable car option (extra cost ~100 CNY round trip). Book tickets online. Allow 4-5 hours including travel. Wear comfortable shoes. May is ideal weather.
attractions.notes_local: 外国游客首选长城段，人少景美，可乘缆车（约100元往返）。建议提前网上购票。含交通约需4-5小时，五月天气最佳。

attractions.location_local: 北京市延庆区八达岭
attractions.notes_base: Most famous and fully restored Great Wall section. More crowded than Mutianyu but excellent accessibility with high-speed train from Beijing North Station (~1 hour). Advance booking strongly recommended during May holiday.
attractions.notes_local: 最著名的长城段，修缮完好。比慕田峪热闹，但从北京北站乘高铁约1小时可达。五一假期强烈建议提前订票。

attractions.location_base: Yungang Town, Yungang District, Datong, Shanxi (16km west of city)
attractions.location_local: 山西省大同市云冈区云冈镇
attractions.type_local: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产
attractions.notes_base: TICKETS BOOKED for 12:30-14:30 slot. UNESCO World Heritage Site. 45,000+ Buddhist statues carved 5th-6th century across 53 grottoes. Priority grottoes: Caves 16-20 (Tanyao Five Caves — monumental seated Buddhas up to 17m), Caves 5-6 (painted ceilings, Buddha-life relief panels), Caves 9-13 (Five Magnificent Caves). Depart Datong after dropping bags at 屿悦民宿, arrive Yungang by 12:30. Depart Yungang by 14:30 to drive toward Hanging Monastery (~90km southeast via 大同绕城高速, ~1.5-2h drive). Take taxi (~30-40 CNY) or Bus 3/4 from city center (~30 min one-way). Verified via RedNote (practical guide with 14 highlight caves, 213 likes).
attractions.notes_local: 12:30-14:30票已预订。联合国教科文组织世界遗产，53个洞窟内有5-6世纪雕刻佛像超过45,000尊。重点洞窟：16-20窟（昙曜五窟，坐佛最高达17米）、5-6窟（彩绘藻井、佛传故事浮雕）、9-13窟（五华窟）。放行李后从屿悦民宿出发，12:30前抵达云冈石窟，14:30离开前往悬空寺（东南方向约90公里，经大同绕城高速约1.5-2小时）。从市区乘出租车约30-40元，3/4路公交约30分钟可达。小红书已验证（14个精华洞窟实用攻略，213赞）。

search_results.display_text: RedNote - Yungang Grottoes Practical Guide (213 likes)

attractions.location_base: Jinlong Canyon, Hunyuan County, Datong, Shanxi (65km south of Datong city)
attractions.location_local: 山西省大同市浑源县大磁窑镇203省道恒山山腰金龙峡
attractions.notes_base: Day 3 afternoon attraction after Yungang Grottoes. Drive ~90km from Yungang (~1.5-2h via 大同绕城高速); buy tickets on-site. One of China's most spectacular architectural achievements: a Buddhist-Taoist-Confucian monastery literally suspended on wooden poles driven into a sheer cliff face, built 1,500+ years ago (Northern Wei dynasty, 491 AD). Only place in China where the Three Teachings (Buddhism, Taoism, Confucianism) coexist in one site. 40 rooms and halls interconnected by plank walkways across the cliff. Views of Jinlong Canyon below. CRITICAL WARNING: Gaode Maps listed the Hanging Monastery as temporarily closed (zanting kaifang). Verify reopening status before visit: check the official WeChat account or call +86-352-8326502. If confirmed open, timed entry groups are strictly limited. Allow 1.5-2 hours on site. Last entry typically 17:00. Return Datong city for dinner after visit.
attractions.notes_local: 第3天悬空寺（云冈游览后下午前往）。从云冈驾车约90公里（经大同绕城高速约1.5-2小时），现场购票。中国最壮观的建筑奇迹之一：北魏时期（公元491年）建于恒山绝壁之上的悬空寺，以木桩嵌入岩石支撑，融佛道儒三教于一寺，四十余间殿堂经悬空栈道相连，脚下是金龙峡谷。重要警告：高德地图曾标注悬空寺为暂停开放（暂停开放）。参观前务必确认恢复开放时间，建议致电+86-352-8326502核实。若确认开放，限时限流严格。游览约1.5-2小时，末班入场一般17:00。参观结束后返回大同市区用晚餐。

search_results.display_text: Gaode Maps - Hanging Monastery (verify reopening status)

attractions.location_base: Huayan Street, Ancient City Area, Datong, Shanxi
attractions.location_local: 山西省大同市古城区华严寺街
attractions.notes_base: PRIORITY 1 city attraction — full day Datong Ancient City walk starts here. One of China's most important Liao dynasty (916-1125 AD) Buddhist temples. Contains the Daxiong Baodian (Great Hero Treasure Hall) — the largest surviving Liao-period Buddhist hall in China — and the Bojia Jiaocang Lou (1038 AD), a wooden scripture library with extraordinary cabinet carvings including the celebrated smiling Bodhisattva known as the Eastern Venus. Allow 1-1.5 hours. Ticket ~65 CNY. Book online for Labour Day holiday. Verified via RedNote (Huayan & Shanhua double temple guide, 179 likes).
attractions.notes_local: 城区优先级1——大同古城全天步行游首站。中国最重要的辽代（916-1125年）佛教寺院之一。大雄宝殿是中国现存最大辽代佛殿；薄伽教藏楼（建于1038年）内有精美壁藏雕刻，以合掌露齿东方维纳斯菩萨像著称。游览约1-1.5小时，票价约65元，五一假期建议网上预约。小红书已验证（华严寺&善化寺双子星游记，179赞）。

search_results.display_text: RedNote - Huayan & Shanhua Double Temple Guide

attractions.location_base: Nansi Street, Ancient City Area, Datong, Shanxi
attractions.location_local: 山西省大同市古城区南寺街
attractions.notes_base: PRIORITY 2 city attraction — visit after Huayan Temple. One of China's best-preserved ancient temple complexes. Originally Tang dynasty, expanded Liao and Jin dynasties (10th-12th century). Contains four surviving Liao-Jin timber structures along a single central axis — the only site in China with all four — illustrating the full architectural transition from Tang to Jin styles. The Sansheng Hall and Great Hero Hall are highlights. Less crowded than Huayan. Allow 45-60 min. Ticket ~40 CNY. Described by RedNote users as a Liao-Jin architecture museum. Verified via RedNote (179 likes).
attractions.notes_local: 城区优先级2——华严寺游览结束后前往。中国保存最完好的古代寺庙建筑群之一，始建于唐代，辽金时期（10-12世纪）扩建。沿中轴线保存有四座辽金木构建筑，是中国唯一一处集齐四座辽金木构的寺院，完整呈现从唐风到金代的建筑演变。三圣殿与大雄宝殿是参观重点，人少清净。游览约45-60分钟，票价约40元。小红书用户称其为辽金建筑博物馆，已验证（179赞）。

search_results.display_text: RedNote - Huayan & Shanhua Double Temple Guide

attractions.name_base: Prince Dai Mansion and Nine Dragon Screen (代王府九龙壁)
attractions.location_base: Heping Road, Ancient City Area, Datong, Shanxi
attractions.location_local: 山西省大同市古城区和平路
attractions.notes_base: PRIORITY 3 — reconstructed Ming dynasty palace of Prince Zhu Guilei (Dai Wang), originally built 1374 AD. The Nine Dragon Screen (built 1392 AD) is the oldest and largest surviving nine-dragon glazed tile screen in China, predating Beijing's versions. Located ~5 min walk from Shanhua Temple. Ticket ~80 CNY. Allow 45-60 min. Focus on Nine Dragon Screen + main gate. Verified via RedNote (Datong Ancient City CityWalk guide, 1834 likes).
attractions.notes_local: 城区优先级3——明代代王朱桂王府，始建于1374年，约2020年完成复原。宫殿前九龙壁（建于1392年）是中国现存最古老、最大的九龙琉璃照壁，比北京版本更早。距善化寺步行约5分钟，票价约80元，游览约45-60分钟。重点参观九龙壁与主仪门。小红书已验证（大同古城CityWalk攻略，1834赞）。

search_results.display_text: RedNote - Datong Ancient City CityWalk Guide

attractions.name_base: Datong Ancient City Wall (大同古城墙)
attractions.location_local: 山西省大同市古城城墙
attractions.notes_base: PRIORITY 4 — walk the restored Ming dynasty city wall surrounding Datong Ancient City. One of the best-preserved ancient city walls in northern China. The wall circuit is ~7.6 km; walk a section (1-2 km) for panoramic views over the ancient city rooflines and surrounding area. Four original gate towers restored. Best light in late afternoon before evening split. Ticket ~30 CNY. Accessible from multiple gates adjacent to Huayan and Shanhua temples. Allow 45-60 min for a section walk. Evening transport split departs from here — Matilde to DAT airport, Jade to Datong South HSR station.
attractions.notes_local: 城区优先级4——步行大同古城明代城墙。城墙全长约7.6公里，是华北保存最完好的古城墙之一，四座城门楼均已修复。选走一段（约1-2公里）可俯瞰古城屋脊与周边景色，傍晚光线最美。票价约30元，从华严寺和善化寺附近多处城门均可登城。游览约45-60分钟。傍晚各自出行：Matilde前往大同机场（DAT），Jade前往大同南高铁站。

search_results.display_text: Gaode Maps - Datong Ancient City Wall
RedNote - Datong Ancient City CityWalk Guide

attractions.location_local: 四川省成都市武侯区锦里
attractions.notes_base: Atmospheric ancient-style street adjacent to Wuhou Shrine (Three Kingdoms era). Excellent for first evening in Chengdu. Traditional Sichuan architecture, street food (skewers, rice cakes, sweet water noodles), local handicrafts, and street performers. Free entry, evening atmosphere is magical.
attractions.notes_local: 紧邻武侯祠的仿古街道，是成都第一晚的绝佳去处。传统川式建筑，有串串、糍粑、甜水面等地方小吃，以及当地手工艺品和街头表演。免费进入，夜晚氛围尤为迷人。

attractions.location_local: 四川省成都市武侯区武侯祠大街231号
attractions.notes_base: China's only museum combining both a temple to Prime Minister Zhuge Liang and Emperor Liu Bei's mausoleum, from the Three Kingdoms period. Adjacent to Jinli Street. Optional daytime addition if arriving early.
attractions.notes_local: 中国唯一将诸葛亮祠堂与刘备陵墓合二为一的博物馆，三国时期古迹。紧邻锦里，如早到可顺道游览。

attractions.location_base: Lingyun Road 2435, Shizhong District, Leshan, Sichuan
attractions.location_local: 四川省乐山市市中区凌云路2435号
attractions.type_local: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产
attractions.notes_base: World's largest stone Buddha statue at 71 meters, UNESCO listed. Take high-speed rail Chengdu→Leshan (1 hour, ~30 CNY) or tourist bus. You can view from river boat (50 CNY) or walk down the cliff stairs for close-up. Ticket ~90 CNY including Wuyou Temple. Book tickets online for May holiday. Allow half day.
attractions.notes_local: 世界最大石佛，高71米，联合国教科文组织世界遗产。可乘高铁（成都→乐山约1小时，约30元）或旅游大巴前往。可乘游船从水上观看（约50元）或沿悬崖步道近距离参观。含乌尤寺套票约90元，五一假期建议网上购票，游览需半天时间。

attractions.location_local: 四川省乐山市市中区乌尤山
attractions.notes_base: Ancient Buddhist temple on a small island adjacent to Leshan Giant Buddha scenic area. Typically included in combined ticket. Walk there via Lingyun Bridge. Beautiful riverside setting with pagodas and lush greenery.
attractions.notes_local: 紧邻乐山大佛景区的小岛上的古佛寺，通常包含在联票中。经凌云桥步行可达。依山傍水，有宝塔和翠绿植被，风景秀美。

attractions.location_base: Near Leshan Giant Buddha Scenic Area, Leshan, Sichuan
attractions.location_local: 四川省乐山市凌云路景区附近
attractions.notes_base: Historic bridge connecting Leshan Giant Buddha area to Wuyou Temple. Excellent vantage point for photos. Walk across as part of the scenic area tour. Free to cross.
attractions.notes_local: 连接乐山大佛景区与乌尤寺的历史古桥，是拍照的绝佳位置，可在景区游览过程中步行过桥，免费通行。

attractions.name_base: Mount Qingcheng - Front Mountain (青城山前山)
attractions.location_local: 四川省成都市都江堰市青城山镇
attractions.type_local: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产
attractions.notes_base: One of China's four sacred Taoist mountains, UNESCO listed. Front Mountain has well-marked hiking trails to Tianshi Cave and Laojun Pavilion (2-3 hours hiking). Take HSR from Chengdu to Dujiangyan (~30 min), then bus/taxi to scenic area. Ticket ~60 CNY. Cable car available (~30 CNY extra). Recommend starting early.
attractions.notes_local: 中国四大道教名山之一，联合国教科文组织世界遗产。前山有清晰的登山步道通往天师洞和老君阁（徒步2-3小时）。从成都乘高铁至都江堰约30分钟，再转公交或出租车到景区。票价约60元，缆车另约30元。建议早出发。

attractions.name_base: People's Park Matchmaking Corner (人民公园相亲角)
attractions.location_local: 四川省成都市青羊区人民公园
attractions.notes_base: Chengdu's famous People's Park hosts a unique weekend matchmaking corner where parents advertise their children's marriage profiles on umbrellas and noticeboards. Best visited Saturday/Sunday morning. Also home to historic teahouses for authentic Sichuan tea culture experience. Free entry to park.
attractions.notes_local: 成都著名的人民公园设有独特的相亲角，家长们在伞和展板上张贴子女的婚配信息，最佳游览时间为周末上午。园内还有历史悠久的茶馆，可体验地道四川茶文化，公园免费入场。

attractions.name_base: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding (大熊猫繁育研究基地)
attractions.name_local: 成都大熊猫繁育研究基地
attractions.location_base: Panda Avenue, Chenghua District, Chengdu, Sichuan
attractions.location_local: 四川省成都市成华区熊猫大道1375号
attractions.notes_base: World-famous giant panda conservation center. Best visited early morning (08:00-10:00) when pandas are most active and feeding. Over 80 giant pandas and red pandas. Ticket ~100 CNY, must book online in advance (sells out fast especially May holiday). Allow 3-4 hours. Take Metro Line 3 or tourist bus from city center.
attractions.notes_local: 世界著名大熊猫保护中心。建议早晨8-10时前往，此时大熊猫最活跃且正在进食。现有超过80只大熊猫和小熊猫。票价约100元，需提前网上购票（五一假期期间极易售罄）。游览需3-4小时。可乘地铁3号线或旅游巴士从市中心前往。

attractions.location_base: Bell Tower Square, Xincheng District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
attractions.location_local: 陕西省西安市新城区钟楼广场
attractions.notes_base: Iconic 14th-century Ming Dynasty bell tower at the heart of Xi'an. Good orientation point for the city center. Evening view is spectacular when illuminated. Easy evening stroll on arrival from train station. Ticket ~30 CNY. Combined ticket with Drum Tower available.
attractions.notes_local: 西安市中心标志性的明代钟楼（14世纪），是认识城市的好起点。夜晚灯光璀璨，景色壮观，适合从火车站到达后的傍晚游览。票价约30元，可购买与鼓楼的联票。

attractions.name_base: Terracotta Warriors Museum (秦始皇兵马俑博物馆)
attractions.location_local: 陕西省西安市临潼区秦始皇陵博物院
attractions.type_local: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产
attractions.notes_base: One of the world's greatest archaeological discoveries - 8,000+ life-sized terracotta soldiers guarding China's first emperor. MUST BOOK IN ADVANCE online (especially May holiday). Ticket ~120 CNY. Take Tourist Bus 5 from Xi'an Railway Station (1 hour). Allow 3-4 hours. Three main pits plus museum. Arrive early to beat crowds.
attractions.notes_local: 世界最重要的考古发现之一，8000余件真人大小的兵马俑守卫中国第一位皇帝。五一假期必须提前网上购票。票价约120元，可乘旅游5路公交从西安火车站出发（约1小时）。游览需3-4小时，含三个主要坑道和博物馆。建议早到以避开人群。

attractions.name_base: Grand Mosque of Xi'an (西安化觉巷清真大寺)
attractions.location_base: 30 Huajue Lane, Lianhu District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
attractions.location_local: 陕西省西安市莲湖区化觉巷30号
attractions.notes_base: One of China's largest and oldest mosques, founded in 742 AD. Unique blend of Chinese imperial architecture with Islamic design. Located in the Muslim Quarter. Ticket ~25 CNY. Non-Muslims welcome outside prayer times. Allow 45-60 minutes. Great afternoon activity after Terracotta Warriors.
attractions.notes_local: 中国最大、历史最悠久的清真寺之一，始建于公元742年。融合中国皇家建筑与伊斯兰风格的独特设计。位于回民街内。票价约25元，非穆斯林可在非礼拜时间参观。游览需45-60分钟，是游览兵马俑后的绝佳下午活动。

attractions.location_local: 陕西省西安市莲湖区北院门回民街
attractions.notes_base: Return to the Muslim Quarter for evening street food. Try different stalls from Day 9 visit. The atmosphere is most vibrant after dark. Adjacent to Bell Tower night view.
attractions.notes_local: 傍晚再次造访回民街品尝地方小吃，可尝试与第9天不同的摊位。夜幕降临后氛围最为热闹，毗邻钟楼夜景。

attractions.name_base: Bell Tower and Drum Tower Night View (钟楼鼓楼夜景)
attractions.location_base: Bell Tower Square, Xincheng District, Xi'an, Shaanxi
attractions.location_local: 陕西省西安市新城区钟楼广场
attractions.notes_base: Evening visit to Xi'an's iconic Bell Tower and adjacent Drum Tower. Both magnificently lit at night. The Bell Tower (1384 AD) and Drum Tower (1380 AD) are best photographed from each other's vantage point. Combined ticket ~50 CNY. Plan for sunset and evening stay.
attractions.notes_local: 傍晚游览西安标志性的钟楼和鼓楼，两处夜晚灯光璀璨。钟楼（1384年）和鼓楼（1380年）从对方角度拍照效果最佳。联票约50元，建议安排日落前后前往。

attractions.location_local: 陕西省西安市莲湖区北院门鼓楼
attractions.notes_base: 14th-century Ming Dynasty drum tower adjacent to the Muslim Quarter. Evening drum performance shows available. Spectacular when illuminated at night. Included in combined ticket with Bell Tower.
attractions.notes_local: 毗邻回民街的明代鼓楼（14世纪），夜间有鼓乐表演，灯光璀璨。含在与钟楼的联票中。

attractions.name_base: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda Musical Fountain (大雁塔音乐喷泉)
attractions.name_local: 大雁塔北广场音乐喷泉
attractions.location_local: 陕西省西安市雁塔区慈恩路1号大雁塔北广场
attractions.notes_base: Asia's largest musical fountain show at the north square of the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda. FREE show typically runs Friday-Sunday 20:00-21:00, with the 7th-century pagoda as backdrop. Check schedule as times vary. Take Metro Line 3. Also worth seeing the pagoda itself during the day (ticket ~40 CNY).
attractions.notes_local: 亚洲最大音乐喷泉，位于大雁塔北广场，以唐代佛塔为背景。免费表演通常在周五至周日20:00-21:00举行，时间表可能有变，建议提前确认。可乘地铁3号线前往。白天也值得参观大雁塔（票价约40元）。

search_results.display_text: Gaode Maps - Wild Goose Pagoda Fountain

attractions.name_base: Xi'an Ancient City Wall (西安古城墙)
attractions.location_local: 陕西省西安市中心区西安城墙
attractions.notes_base: Most complete ancient city wall in China, built in 1370 AD. Rent a bicycle to ride the full 13.7 km circuit (~45 min). Ticket ~54 CNY, bike rental ~45 CNY/hour. Great afternoon daytime activity before evening Bell/Drum Tower visit.
attractions.notes_local: 中国保存最完整的古城墙，建于1370年。可租自行车骑行全程13.7公里（约45分钟）。门票约54元，自行车租赁约45元/小时。适合作为傍晚游览钟鼓楼之前的下午活动。

attractions.location_base: Zhongshan East Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai
attractions.location_local: 上海市黄浦区中山东一路外滩
attractions.notes_base: Shanghai's most iconic waterfront promenade with historic European-style buildings from the colonial era facing the futuristic Pudong skyline. Spectacular at night when both sides are illuminated. Perfect arrival evening activity after check-in. Walk the full 1.5 km promenade. Best viewing spot: by the Peace Hotel. Free.
attractions.notes_local: 上海最标志性的滨水步道，一侧是殖民时代的欧式建筑，另一侧是现代化的浦东天际线。夜晚两岸灯火辉煌，景色壮观。是到达后入住酒店的绝佳晚间活动。可步行全长1.5公里的步道，和平饭店附近是最佳观景点，免费参观。

attractions.location_local: 上海市黄浦区安仁街218号豫园
attractions.notes_base: Exquisite 16th-century Ming Dynasty classical Chinese garden with pavilions, rockeries, ponds, and traditional architecture. Ticket ~40 CNY. Adjacent to the Old Town bazaar (free). Get there early morning to avoid crowds. Allow 1.5-2 hours inside. Book tickets online for May holiday.
attractions.notes_local: 精美的明代古典园林（16世纪），内有亭台楼阁、假山池沼和传统建筑。票价约40元，紧邻免费的老城隍庙商业区。建议早晨前往以避开人群，园内游览需1.5-2小时。五一假期建议网上购票。

attractions.name_base: Shanghai Old Town - Chenghuang Temple Area (上海老城区城隍庙)
attractions.location_base: Fangbang Middle Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai
attractions.location_local: 上海市黄浦区方浜中路城隍庙地区
attractions.notes_base: Shanghai's old town area surrounding the City God Temple. Lively bazaar with traditional snacks (xiaolongbao soup dumplings, glutinous rice cakes), souvenir shops, and street atmosphere. Free to explore the streets. Best combined with Yu Garden visit.
attractions.notes_local: 围绕城隍庙的上海老城区，有热闹的集市，可品尝传统小吃（小笼包、年糕）、购买纪念品，街头气氛热闹。逛街免费，建议与豫园游览结合进行。

attractions.name_base: Oriental Pearl Tower (东方明珠广播电视塔)
attractions.location_local: 上海市浦东新区世纪大道1号东方明珠广播电视塔
attractions.notes_base: Shanghai's iconic TV tower and symbol of modern China. Panoramic observation deck with 360 degree views of the city. Ticket ~150 CNY (various levels). Located in Lujiazui financial district, easily combined with Bund views from across the river. Best visited afternoon for daytime city views.
attractions.notes_local: 上海标志性电视塔，现代中国的象征。设有360度全景观景台。票价约150元（不同高度不同价格）。位于陆家嘴金融区，可与外滩对岸观景结合游览。建议下午前往欣赏白天城市景观。

attractions.location_local: 上海市黄浦区泰康路田子坊
attractions.notes_base: Former 1930s residential lanes converted into a bohemian arts and craft district. Maze of narrow alleyways with independent boutiques, cafes, galleries, and studios. Free to enter. Excellent for unique souvenirs and local design products. Best in afternoon when shops are open.
attractions.notes_local: 1930年代的旧式里弄改造而成的波西米亚风格艺术区，蜿蜒小巷内遍布独立精品店、咖啡馆、画廊和工作室。免费进入，非常适合购买独特纪念品和本土设计产品，下午各店铺营业时段最佳。

attractions.location_local: 上海市浦东新区锦绣路1078号世纪公园
attractions.notes_base: Shanghai's largest park in Pudong, with lakes, meadows, and walking paths. Ideal if needing a green break from the city. Ticket ~10 CNY. May is excellent timing with spring flowers. Optional if the day gets too full.
attractions.notes_local: 上海浦东最大公园，内有湖泊、草坪和步行道。若需从城市喧嚣中抽身休憩，这里是理想去处。票价约10元。五月正值春花盛开，景色宜人。如当天行程过于紧凑可跳过。

attractions.location_local: 上海市黄浦区人民广场
attractions.notes_base: Shanghai's central plaza surrounded by cultural institutions including the Shanghai Museum (free), Shanghai Urban Planning Exhibition Center. Large open area for walking. Good transport hub. Optional if time allows.
attractions.notes_local: 上海市中心广场，周边有上海博物馆（免费）和上海城市规划展示馆等文化场所，是市内交通枢纽，如时间允许可顺道游览。

attractions.location_base: 4 Jingshan Front Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing
attractions.location_local: 北京市东城区景山前街4号故宫博物院
attractions.type_local: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产
attractions.notes_base: World's largest palace complex, UNESCO listed. 600-year-old Ming Dynasty imperial palace with 980 buildings across 72 hectares. MUST book timed-entry tickets online in advance (sells out weeks ahead especially May holiday). Ticket ~60 CNY. Allow 3-4 hours. Enter from south (Meridian Gate), exit north toward Jingshan Park.
attractions.notes_local: 世界最大宫殿建筑群，联合国教科文组织世界遗产。拥有600年历史的明代皇家宫殿，占地72公顷，有980座建筑。必须提前网上购买定时入场票（五一假期提前数周即可售罄）。票价约60元。游览需3-4小时。从南门（午门）进，从北门出前往景山公园。

attractions.location_base: 44 Jingshan West Street, Xicheng District, Beijing
attractions.location_local: 北京市西城区景山西街44号景山公园
attractions.notes_base: Artificial hill park directly north of the Forbidden City, offering the best panoramic aerial view of the entire palace complex. Climb to Wanchun Pavilion at the top (30 min). Ticket ~2 CNY. Perfect complement after Forbidden City visit. May tulips and peonies may still be blooming.
attractions.notes_local: 位于故宫正北方的人工山丘公园，是俯瞰整个故宫建筑群的最佳全景位置。登顶万春亭约需30分钟。票价约2元，与故宫游览完美搭配。五月可能仍有郁金香和牡丹花盛开。

attractions.location_local: 北京市东城区天坛路天坛公园
attractions.type_local: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产
attractions.notes_base: Magnificent 15th-century Ming Dynasty complex where emperors prayed for good harvests. UNESCO listed. The Hall of Prayer for Good Harvests is an architectural masterpiece. Park ticket ~15 CNY, through ticket ~30 CNY. Allow 2 hours. Alternate choice if Forbidden City is fully booked.
attractions.notes_local: 壮观的明代建筑群（15世纪），为皇帝祭天祈福之处，联合国教科文组织世界遗产。祈年殿是建筑杰作。公园门票约15元，联票约30元。游览需2小时。若故宫票已售罄可作为替代选择。

attractions.location_local: 北京市海淀区新建宫门路19号颐和园
attractions.type_local: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产
attractions.notes_base: China's largest imperial garden, UNESCO listed. Built around Kunming Lake with Longevity Hill, Long Corridor, and marble boat. Ticket ~30 CNY (peak season). Allow 3-4 hours. Located in Haidian district (~45 min from city center). Alternate full-day choice instead of Forbidden City.
attractions.notes_local: 中国最大皇家园林，联合国教科文组织世界遗产。围绕昆明湖建造，有万寿山、长廊和石舫。旺季票价约30元。游览需3-4小时，位于海淀区（距市中心约45分钟）。可作为代替故宫的全天游览选择。

attractions.name_base: National Museum of China (中国国家博物馆)
attractions.location_base: 16 East Chang'an Avenue, Dongcheng District, Beijing
attractions.location_local: 北京市东城区东长安街16号中国国家博物馆
attractions.notes_base: One of the world's largest museums housing 1.4 million artifacts spanning Chinese civilization. FREE but advance online reservation required. Located on Tiananmen Square. Allow 2-3 hours minimum. Good morning activity on departure day if flight is afternoon/evening. Closed on Mondays.
attractions.notes_local: 世界最大博物馆之一，藏有140万件涵盖中华文明的文物。免费参观但需提前网上预约。位于天安门广场旁。至少游览2-3小时。若航班在下午或傍晚，是出发日早晨的好选择。周一闭馆。

search_results.display_text: Gaode Maps - National Museum of China

attractions.name_base: Mao Zedong Memorial Hall (毛主席纪念堂)
attractions.location_local: 北京市东城区天安门广场毛主席纪念堂
attractions.notes_base: Mausoleum of Chairman Mao Zedong on Tiananmen Square. View the preserved body in the crystal sarcophagus. FREE but requires advance registration online. Open morning only (08:00-12:00, closed Monday & Friday). Queue can be very long. No bags allowed (deposit nearby). Compact visit ~30-45 min.
attractions.notes_local: 天安门广场上的毛泽东主席纪念堂，可瞻仰水晶棺中保存的遗体。免费但需提前网上登记。仅上午开放（08:00-12:00，周一、周五闭馆）。排队可能很长，不可携带包（就近寄存）。参观约需30-45分钟。

attractions.location_local: 北京市东城区天安门广场
attractions.notes_base: World's largest public square, central to Chinese history and culture. Walk across the square to see the Monument to the People's Heroes and view Tiananmen Gate (Gate of Heavenly Peace). Free to enter the square. ID/passport required for entry. Easy to combine with National Museum and Mao Memorial visits.
attractions.notes_local: 世界最大公共广场，是中国历史和文化的中心。可步行穿越广场参观人民英雄纪念碑和天安门城楼。广场免费进入，需出示身份证或护照。可与国家博物馆和毛主席纪念堂游览结合进行。
